answer_1.quote: We focus on the recently introduced extreme summarization dataset (XSUM) ... The task aims to create a single-sentence summary of a news article ...

answer_2.quote: We report on ROUGE (Lin and Hovy, 2003) scores, BERTScore and semantic inference metric such as textual entailment and question answering.

answer_4.quote: We have trained annotators (fluent in English) specifically for our assessment. ... annotators were presented an article and a single-sentence summary ... they were tasked with (i) identifying hallucinated spans and (ii) annotating intrinsic or extrinsic hallucination ... they also assessed factuality using external resources.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to assess hallucinations, classify them as intrinsic or extrinsic, and judge factuality of each hallucinated span; additional assessments included repetition and incoherence.
